jobs.description:
This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Diegem at the border with Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

The company is an international player in the chemical industry, focused on producing basic raw materials derived from oil and gas. These materials are used by other companies to manufacture products such as packaging, plastic components, industrial applications, and consumer goods.

Operating on a global scale, the organization combines manufacturing, logistics, and international trade within a highly integrated business model. The work environment is strongly process-driven, with a focus on quality, supply chain excellence, and customer satisfaction.

In addition, the company places a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, investing in more efficient production processes and the development of increasingly recyclable materials.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery	
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy	
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing	
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments	
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints	
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools	
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams	
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues	
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives	
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments

Requirements
	
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience	
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management	
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset	
• Experience in the shipping industry	
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)	
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage	
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously	
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy	
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset	
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills	
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment	
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Do you want to schedule your own day?

Do you want to decide when you take your breaks? 

Do you want to work in a nice and warm environment?

As a Production worker you are responsible for wrapping and packing of several plastic goods. You check the quality and labels the orders. Afterwards you stack everything on the pallet.

• You have experience as a production worker.
• You can work in 3 shifts (morning, afternoon and night)
• You speak and understand English well
• You have your own transportation.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

As a 
Quotation Engineer, you will support the commercial process from A to Z. You will work closely with the Sales team and have direct contact with customers to fully understand their technical requirements and expectations. Your ability to analyze information, interpret specifications, and propose suitable solutions will be key to delivering accurate and competitive quotations.
 

Thanks to your analytical mindset and customer-focused approach, you ensure that every proposal is technically sound, commercially attractive, and perfectly aligned with customer expectations. At the same time, you contribute to efficient processes and foster strong collaboration between all stakeholders involved. 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

As a Quotation Engineer, you will:

• Work closely with the Sales team to prepare quotations, pricing proposals, and technical solutions for our customers. 

• Maintain direct contact with customers to fully understand their needs, technical requirements, and expectations. 

• Analyze customer specifications and translate them into the standard solutions and capabilities offered by RapidFit Plus. 

• Accurately interpret customer expectations and align them with internal technical and operational requirements. 

• Collect and provide all necessary information to ensure accurate cost calculations and the preparation of competitive quotations. 

• Prepare clear, accurate, and customer-focused quotations that meet customer needs and requirements. 

• Ensure proposed solutions are presented transparently and that the scope of services is clearly defined and documented. 

• Collaborate closely with Project Engineers to guarantee a smooth transfer of information during project kick-off and implementation meetings. 

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of sales processes, quotation workflows, and customer collaboration. 

• Ensure timely and accurate processing and maintenance of customer, project, and quotation data within the ERP system. 
 

 

• You hold a degree in Industrial Engineering. 

• Experience in a technical environment such as automotive, machine building, tooling, mold manufacturing, plastics processing, or production engineering is a strong asset.

• You possess strong analytical skills and can easily interpret technical specifications. 

• You communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. 

• You work in a structured, accurate, and solution-oriented manner. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel. 

• You have an affinity for digitalization and technological innovation. 

• You have an excellent command of English. 

• An interest in AI applications and their potential to improve business processes is considered a valuable asset.

As a Personal Assistant in the fashion industry, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure smooth and efficient operations. This role is based in Brussels and requires strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Description

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3+ years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

A leading global organization with a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and business growth. The company offers a stable working environment, international exposure, and opportunities for professional development.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide 1st level IT support for hardware, software, network, printers, and end-user devices.
• Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot IT equipment and applications.
• Support users with daily IT issues and ensure smooth business operations.
• Coordinate with regional and global IT teams on projects and technical initiatives.
• Manage IT assets, including computers, servers, and network equipment.
• Maintain IT inventory, infrastructure documentation, and network diagrams.
• Monitor and maintain server room and IT infrastructure performance.
• Support IT procurement and ensure alignment with company standards.
• Administer business systems, user access, backups, and recovery processes.
• Perform system maintenance, upgrades, and routine health checks.
• Support change management, documentation, and compliance activities.
• Ensure systems are secure, reliable, and properly documented.
• Support audits, business continuity, and disaster recovery activities.
• Work closely with business users and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance IT services and processes.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft technologies and enterprise IT environments.
• Experience supporting servers, virtualization platforms, and network infrastructure.
• Good understanding of system security, access management, backup, and recovery processes.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication skills in Thai and English.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills.
• Willingness to provide after-hours support when required.

The hiring company is a multinational organization with a long-standing presence in the global market.

Jobomschrijving

• Oversee day-to-day IT operations, ensuring reliable infrastructure and support services.
• Manage and maintain server environments, network infrastructure, VPN connectivity, and security solutions.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for end users and business-critical systems.
• Support enterprise applications, user access management, and system integrations.

• Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for maintenance and support activities.
• Support internal audits, compliance requirements, and IT governance initiatives.
• Identify and implement improvements to enhance system performance, security, and operational efficiency.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• 5-7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, networking, or IT operations.
• Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux server administration.
• Experience supporting network environments including LAN, WAN, VPN, and security technologies.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, databases, and cloud platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of IT service management, security, and compliance practices.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills in Thai and English.
• Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

The hiring company is a well-established multinational organization with a strong global presence and a long-term commitment to operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. The company offers a collaborative international environment, exposure to global best practices, and opportunities to contribute to impactful business and technology initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute IT strategies, budgets, and operational plans aligned with business objectives.
• Oversee IT infrastructure, networks, servers, databases, and business applications to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
• Lead enterprise system initiatives, enhancements, integrations, and process improvement projects.
• Drive cybersecurity, risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery programs.
• Ensure IT governance, compliance, and best practice adoption across the organization.
• Manage IT vendors, service providers, contracts, and service-level performance.
• Lead, mentor, and develop the local IT team while fostering a high-performance culture.
• Collaborate with regional and global teams on technology standards, implementations, and strategic initiatives.
• Identify opportunities for innovation, automation, and operational efficiency improvements.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, enterprise systems, and IT operations, including people management responsibilities.
• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and systems administration.
• Experience supporting ERP platforms and enterprise applications.
• Familiarity with cloud technologies, database management, and IT service management practices.
• Proven leadership, stakeholder management, and project delivery capabilities.
• Strong communication skills in both Thai and English.
• Strategic mindset with hands-on problem-solving abilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Manager - Retail textile sector
jobs.description:
The client is a textile and garment manufacturer, specialized in denim, jeans and workwear, producing for European fashion brands and retailers. The company combines local manufacturing expertise, industrial capabilities and nearshore production, with a strong focus on quality, flexibility and fast delivery to the European market. 

Jobomschrijving

As the company establishes its new structure in Belgium, it is looking for a Senior Business Developer to lead its re-entry into the European markets.

The Role:

As Senior Business Developer, you will drive business development in Belgium, with a gradual expansion into the Netherlands, Luxembourg and Northern France.

• Build and develop the Belgian market
• Leverage and activate your existing network within the textile industry
• Prospect and acquire new clients, including brands, retailers and distributors
• Manage the full sales cycle through to closing
• Contribute to the company's repositioning and commercial strategy
• Work closely with the industrial teams based in Tunisia

• Minimum 5 years of experience in textile business development
• Strong and active network across the Benelux
• Experience in sourcing or on the brand side is a strong asset
• Entrepreneurial mindset, highly autonomous and results-oriented
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English

jobs.occupation: Stability Engineer - Sector Leader - Brussels Region
jobs.description:
Our client is a company specialised in technical solutions for construction projects, active across a wide range of sites in Belgium. It relies on an internal engineering team responsible for analysing, optimising, and preparing the technical aspects of projects. To support its development, the organisation is strengthening its design office with a Dutch-speaking engineer.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the technical analysis of projects and the preparation of offers
• Explore different design approaches and propose suitable technical solutions
• Collaborate with internal teams to assess constraints, risks, and opportunities
• Support the preparation of technical documents and project files
• Take responsibility for complete technical studies related to project design and execution
• Provide technical support to operational teams during project start-up and follow-up
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of methods, tools, and processes within the design office
• Work on projects requiring in-depth technical or structural analysis.

• Civil or industrial engineer with a strong interest in technical analysis and design
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good understanding of English and French
• Rigorous, analytical, and comfortable with calculations and modelling
• Enjoys teamwork and contributing to varied projects
• Motivated to grow in an environment where technique, precision, and collaboration are essential

Our client is an established international company active within the insurance sector. With a strong presence in Belgium, they focus on delivering high-quality services while continuously improving their operations and processes.

They are currently looking for a Manager Accounts Payable & Treasury to join their Brussels office.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coach and develop a team within Accounts Payable and Treasury
• Responsible for recruitment, performance management and team development
• Ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and bank transactions
• Oversee month-end and quarter-end closings within AP & Treasury
• Guarantee the quality, accuracy and compliance of financial processes
• Organise, monitor and optimise workflows
• Drive continuous improvement of processes and systems
• Ensure strong internal controls and compliance with regulations
• Act as a key stakeholder and business partner within Finance and across departments

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or similar
• Relevant experience within Accounts Payable and Treasury
• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes
• Experience with SAP FI and financial systems
• Advanced Excel skills
• Good understanding of compliance, tax and internal controls
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
• Proven experience in people management and coaching
• Strong organisational and planning skills
• Analytical mindset with problem-solving capabilities
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proactive, hands-on and improvement-driven
• Team player with a high sense of ownership

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive local and international IT projects, including ERP and digital platform transformations.
• Support and optimize business-critical applications such as ERP, e-commerce, CRM, and customer support tools.
• Act as the go-to expert for users, system integrations, and operational excellence.
• Ensure IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection remain robust and future-ready.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to deliver seamless digital experiences.

• 5+ years of experience in IT systems, applications, or project management.
• Strong ERP expertise; SAP experience is a major plus.
• Knowledge of e-commerce platforms (Shopify is a bonus).
• Broad understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and user support.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an asset.

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. 

B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. 

Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

About the role

As Group Marketing Director, you lead Beaulieu's central marketing team. Guided by strategic insights, you act as the group's marketing center of excellence, shaping marketing strategy and supporting divisions in building and executing their growth plans.
In parallel, you oversee the shared marketing services within Beaulieu, including events, graphic design, and digital marketing, ensuring every division benefits from consistent, high-quality execution.
You lead a team of marketing professionals, combining strategic vision with hands-on leadership to translate ideas into impact and ensure that both strategy and execution meet the highest standards.

 

Key responsibilities
 
• You collaborate closely with divisional management and marketeers to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive growth. Acting as a strategic partner, you help identify where marketing can create the greatest impact, align priorities, and turn direction into measurable action. 
• You act as a trusted marketing partner to senior management and division leaders, translating their commercial priorities into marketing action, and representing marketing's voice in group-level decision-making. 
• You lead, coach, and develop the central marketing team, bringing together expertise in CRM, events, graphic design, and digital marketing. You set clear priorities and ensures the team operates as both a center of excellence and a trusted shared services partner to the divisions. 
• Together with divisional marketing teams, you lead the execution of creative, high-impact campaigns across the group, translating strategic priorities into initiatives that deliver results. 
• In close collaboration with divisional marketing and sales teams, you ensure marketing acts as a true commercial growth partner. You provide the insights, tools, and content that help sales engage customers more effectively, while aligning messaging, positioning, and value propositions. 
• You oversee relationships with external partners, including agencies, freelancers, and technology providers, ensuring high-quality delivery and maximizing the value of external expertise across the group. 
• You own the group marketing budget, allocating resources across shared services and divisional needs, and ensuring spend translates into measurable ROI. 
• You lead the group's CRM center of excellence, developing the capabilities, standards, and support needed to maximize the value of Salesforce CRM across the organization. By driving adoption, enabling best practices, and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you ensure CRM is leveraged consistently and effectively across departments. 
• You work closely with the Corporate Communications Director to ensure strong alignment between marketing and communication efforts across the organization. By coordinating branding initiatives, organizational events, and strategic communications, you drive consistency, leverage synergies, and avoid duplication of efforts across the group.  
 

What you bring
 
• At least 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Experience within an international, multi-business organization with a central/decentralized operating model is a plus. 
• Strategic marketing: you know how to segment markets, define positioning, and translate market insights into a marketing strategy and plan aligned with business needs. Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies with measurable business impact. 
• Digital marketing: SEO/GEO, paid advertising, email marketing and automation, and digital experience and platforms. Solid understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics. 
• Lead generation: You know how to design and drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and support the sales funnel. 
• You are a trusted partner who operates seamlessly across organizational boundaries. Bridging group and divisional interests, strategic priorities and business execution, and marketing and executive leadership, you create alignment, build commitment, and help the organization move forward with a shared sense of purpose. 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English). 
• Proactive, structured, and results-oriented with a hands-on mentality.
